integrity: The all-parameter theorem follows from an explicit cubic spectral-abscissa argument. Finite and numerical checks are reproducibility aids, not an independent audit. The EP3 point and general Liouvillian EP phenomena are prior art; no priority claim is made for their existence.
scientific_limitations: Single qubit; one full-rank Hermitian Pauli dephasing jump; positive fixed Hamiltonian frequency and dephasing rate; spectral decay exponent rather than minimum finite-time contraction. Generic Lindblad generators and time-varying controls excluded.
title: Exact three-regime dephasing-axis control of the single-qubit Liouvillian spectral gap
